en.headline: Police reclassify Central wounding case as murder after man dies
en.dek: A 41-year-old foreign man who was found injured outside Connaught Place on 7 November was certified dead on Thursday, and two men previously charged remain remanded.
body: Police on Thursday reclassified a wounding case in Central on 7 November as murder. At 8.58pm on 7 November, police received a report that a man collapsed outside Connaught Place. Officers found a 41-year-old foreign man lying on the ground. Sustaining head injuries, he was rushed to Queen Mary Hospital in an unconscious state. Initial investigation revealed that the man was suspectedly assaulted with fists and feet. The assailants then fled.

Police arrested two foreign men, aged 44 and 52, for wounding in Kowloon City and Wan Chai respectively on 8 November. The two arrested men have been laid a holding charge with one count of wounding with intent to do grievous bodily harm. The case was mentioned at Eastern Magistrates' Courts on 10 November, and the two arrested men are remanded in the custody of the Correctional Services Department.

The injured man was certified dead this afternoon. Upon further investigation, police reclassified the case as murder. Post-mortem examinations will be conducted later to ascertain the cause of death of the deceased. Active investigation by the District Crime Squad of Central District is underway.
Anyone who witnessed the case or has any information to offer is urged to contact the investigating officers.

zh.headline: 警方將中環傷人案改列謀殺案 䇩歲外籍男子證實不治
zh.dek: 11月7日在康樂廣場對開倒地受傷的41歲外籍男子於周四下午證實死亡，兩名早前被捕男子仍還押候審。
body: 警方周四將ᆸ月7日在中環發生的一宗傷人案改列為謀殺案。11月7日晚上8時58分，警方接報指一名男子在康樂廣場對開暈倒。人員趕赴現場，發現一名41歲外籍男子倒躺地上，頭部受傷，昏迷被送往瑪麗醫院治理。初步調查顯示，該名男子懷疑曾被人以拳腳襲擊，施襲者其後逃去。
警方翼日在九龍城及灣仔，分別拘捕兩名44歲和52歲的外籍男子，涉嫌傷人。兩人均已被暫控一項「意圖造成身體嚴重傷害而傷人」罪，案件已於星期二在東區裁判法院提堂，該兩名被捕男子現時還押懲教署看管。
由於案中受傷男子今日下午被證實死亡，警方經進一步調查後，將案件改列為謀殺案。警方稍後將安排為死者進行驗屍，以確定其死因。中區警區重案組正積極調查案件。
任何目擊案件或有資料提供的人士，請聯絡調查人員。
